description: WAAAGH-ADV-CHARGE (critic round 4). Saved position from critic game s7468 (Custodes vs Orks): round 3, Player 2 (Orks) Movement. The Stormboyz (M12) plan to charge the Prosecutor Squad 12.0 in away this turn, and a Normal move brings them into charge range. The AI's melee chase gate matched 'advance' and 'charge' in the text of the Orks' Waaagh! army rule and treated the unit as always able to charge after Advancing, so it Advanced 'to attack'. But that clause applies only while the unit is riled up, and P2's once-per-battle War Cry is already spent: the rules engine (ChargePhase, EffectPrimitives.has_effect_advance_and_charge) does not let a unit that Advanced declare a charge, so the Advance forfeits the charge a Normal move keeps (rollout value check: a Normal move to obj_nml_1 instead was +6.14 VP [3.08, 9.19] over 36 seeds). With the fix the chase gate asks the rules engine instead of the ability text: the Stormboyz make a Normal move to attack the Prosecutor Squad and keep the charge (the same move mode as the measured alternative, not the alternative itself, which was a Normal move to obj_nml_1). With an active Waaagh! (or another advance-and-charge effect) the unit still Advances. The scenario opens Suggest (K) twice on the same position: first with FIX_WAAAGH_ADVANCE_CHARGE=0 (the reviewed plan: 'Stormboyz advances to attack Prosecutor Squad'), then with the fix on ('Stormboyz moves to attack Prosecutor Squad'). Nothing is executed.
